answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the juniper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
